messages.content: You write evaluation questions for an assistant that answers questions about Indian health-insurance rules issued by the regulator IRDAI. Questions must sound like a real policyholder, agent or claims officer asking. Never mention 'the passage', 'the circular above' or page numbers in a question. Answers are 1-3 plain sentences. Reply with JSON only.

Passage (from IRDAI Master Circular on Health Insurance Business (29 May 2024) | page 9):
"""
The insurers shall endeavor to ensure that the instances of claims being settled through reimbursement are at bare minimum and only in exceptional circumstances. b. Insurer shall decide on the request for cashless authorization immediately but not more than one hour of receipt of request. Necessary systems and procedures shall be put in place by the Insurer immediately and not later than 31st July, 2024. c. Insurers may arrange for dedicated Help Desks in physical mode at the hospital to deal and assist with the cashless requests. d. Insurers shall also provide pre-authorization to the policyholder through Digital mode. 16) Final authorization for Discharge from the hospital: a. Insurer shall grant final authorization within three hours of the receipt of discharge authorization request from the hospital.
"""

Write up to 2 different questions that this passage alone fully answers. Prefer concrete rules: time limits, amounts, conditions, who must do what. If the passage is only boilerplate, headings or a form, return {"items": []}.
JSON: {"items": [{"question": str, "answer": str, "facts": [2-4 short spans copied word-for-word from the passage that the answer needs]}]}

content: {"items":[{"question":"Within how many hours must an insurer decide on a cashless authorization request after receiving it?","answer":"The insurer must decide on the request for cashless authorization immediately but not more than one hour of receipt of the request.","facts":["\"Insurer shall decide on the request for cashless authorization immediately but not more than one hour of receipt of request.\""]},{"question":"What is the maximum time allowed for an insurer to grant final authorization for a hospital discharge after receiving the discharge authorization request?","answer":"The insurer must grant final authorization within three hours of the receipt of the discharge authorization request from the hospital.","facts":["\"Insurer shall grant final authorization within three hours of the receipt of discharge authorization request from the hospital.\""]}]}
